profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at SoFi
profile.summary:
I am a graduate student pursuing a Master of Science in Informations Systems at Northeastern University, Boston.

I have always been enchanted by computer science and used to wonder how a few lines of code can lead to the development of software that we use in our daily life. This curiosity to know how coding works took me on the path of learning programming. To begin, I started learning HTML and CSS at a very early age. I was fascinated and amazed at how I could make beautiful web pages with just plain lines of code. Thereafter, I was sure and choose computer engineering as a field to advance my career and completed my Bachelors in Computer Application where I learned a variety of programming languages and fundamentals, including Java, MySQL, object-oriented programming, data structures and algorithms, and designing relational databases.

Since then, I’ve worked on countless projects in a variety of domains ranging from Graphic Design, UI/UX, Web Development, Mobile App Development, and Software Development.

My area of expertise include - 

Web Technologies: ReactJS, Node/Express, Redux, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, ES6, Bootstrap, WordPress 
Languages & Frameworks: Java, SQL, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Hibernate 
Mobile Development: React Native, Xcode, Android Studio 
Designing Tools: Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch, Figma, InVision 
Databases & Cloud: MySQL, Redis, AWS, MS Azure 
Version Control:  Git, Bit Bucket, GitHub, Azure DevOps 

Having said that I’m always adding new skills to my repertoire and dedicated to perfecting my craft by learning from seasoned developers. 

I am eager to work with motivated and open-minded people that are ready to tackle big challenges and produce innovative results in software and web development. 

Feel free to reach out to me at patel.jaya@northeastern.edu.

positions.title: Web Developer and Designer
positions.description:
•	Created website layouts and user interfaces using React, HTML, CSS and Bootstrap
•	Worked on projects related to website banners, posters, logos and social media graphic etc. using Photoshop and Illustrator 
•	Created HTML email templates and newsletters for marketing campaigns that improved CTR rates by ~25%
•	Established project parameters, wrote proposals for designs, analyzed competitor web sites and produced site maps for approval
•	Involved in domain name registration, web hosting, search engine optimization and maintained client websites on an ongoing basis.

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed an iOS/Android mobile application for Hannaford Kitchen where customers can browse the menu, order meals for pickup, pay via virtual wallet, track order history, reorder from past orders, mark meal as favorite, and manage profiles
•	Developed UI components and application features with React Native and used Redux for centralized state management
•	Utilized Login Radius SDK to store user credentials and added guest access feature so that users can browse menus without login
•	Integrated payment gateway using Braintree SDK
•	Utilized Microsoft App Center for CI/CD, testing, release, distribution, monitoring, and diagnosing the application
•	Worked in a fast-paced Agile SCRUM environment with a cross-capability team, reviewed pull requests, and actively participated in sprint planning sessions and backlog refinement.

positions.title: Web and Graphic Designer
positions.description:
•	Worked with product managers, business and technical stakeholders to formulate designs that address business and user goals    
•	Revamped the customer-facing UI interface for schools operated by Ryan thereby increasing the visitors count.
•	Developed applications by translating UX mockups into responsive, interactive features, using HTML/CSS JavaScript and Bootstrap

positions.title: Web and Graphic Designer
positions.description:
• Created Mockups/Prototypes in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign for potential customer acquisition which were then turned into functional and responsive digital products.
• Migrated static website into responsive web design using Bootstrap to view across all devices while taking into account cross-browser compatibility issues.
• Handled all composition, color, illustration, typography, and branding for projects.
